title: Section 28 — Service of summons where defendant resides in another State — CPC 1908

content.heading: Service of summons where defendant resides in another State
content.text: A summons may be sent for service in another State to such Court and in such manner as may be prescribed by rules in force in that State. The Court to which the summons is sent shall proceed as if it had been issued by such Court and shall then return the summons with the record of service.
